描述_EN: centuries later they were much sought after by collectors. kilns appeared in all parts of china, each kiln with its own specialized products. a systematic classification of the different wares was already well established in the 1400s, whereby ceramics were named after the town in which the kilns operated. this vase was made during the song dynasty (960-1279), the classical period in the history of chinese ceramics. this piece is a guan ware. the best known wares are ru, ding, jun, yaozhou, cizhou, yue, guan, longquan, jian, jizhou and qingbai.
描述_ZN: 几个世纪后，它们受到了收藏家的追捧。 窑炉出现在中国的各个地方，每个窑炉都有自己的专门产品。 在14世纪，对不同器物的系统分类已经很成熟了，据此，陶瓷被以窑场所在的城镇命名。 这个花瓶是在宋代（960-1279）制作的，是中国陶瓷历史上的经典时期。 这件作品是一件关公器。 最著名的器物是汝、定、钧、耀州、慈州、越、关、龙泉、建、吉州和青白。
